items.question: What is Fahrrad Wetter?
items.answer: Fahrrad Wetter is a free web app that provides personalized clothing and gear recommendations for your bike ride based on real-time weather data. Simply enter your starting location, bike type, and riding style — and you'll get a recommendation for what to wear and pack.

items.question: Is Fahrrad Wetter free?
items.answer: Yes, completely free. The app is funded through advertising and affiliate links to recommended products. You don't pay anything extra.

items.question: Do I need an account?
items.answer: No. The core feature — weather lookup and clothing recommendation — works entirely without signing up. An optional account lets you save routes and reuse them more quickly.

items.question: Where does the weather data come from?
items.answer: The weather data comes from professional weather services and is retrieved in real time via standardized APIs. This ensures you always get up-to-date forecasts for your location.

items.question: How accurate are the forecasts?
items.answer: The accuracy matches that of the underlying weather services. For the next 1–3 days, forecasts are generally very reliable. The further into the future, the less accurate they become — as with any weather forecast.

items.question: Can I also check the weather for tomorrow or the day after?
items.answer: Yes, you can select any date in the future. Keep in mind, however, that forecast accuracy decreases over time.

items.question: How are the clothing recommendations calculated?
items.answer: From the combination of temperature, wind speed, precipitation probability, your bike type, and your planned intensity. Each factor affects how warm or cold you'll feel on the bike — for example, a sporty rider on a road bike needs less insulation than a leisurely city cyclist.

items.question: Do the recommendations fit everyone?
items.answer: The recommendations are a well-founded starting point. Personal sensitivity to cold or heat varies — after a few rides with the app, you'll know whether you tend to need one layer more or less.

items.question: Why does the app ask for my location?
items.answer: To retrieve the weather data for your exact starting location. You can also manually enter an address or city if you don't want to use GPS location.

items.question: Does the app work offline?
items.answer: No, an internet connection is required for current weather data. The app fetches fresh data with every request to give you the most accurate recommendation.
